replayValidation.scope: Rebuilt actual ReplayRuntime with per-writer whole-frame serialization; fixture evidence only, not LIVE or recorded-session parity.

implementation: All eleven files exist and typecheck against shared API freeze 92e8d76 (including 5b083e6, 4682509 and 8b939ca). LIVE model runs are not validated. Example 13 follows the tested C# reference correction 9763763.
requirements: Restore declared dependencies with npm --prefix lib/ts ci.
Standalone Node execution uses --experimental-transform-types; strict compile checks also pass.

JSONL uses native fs-ext flock on POSIX and LockFileEx on Windows. macOS lock refusal and crash release were validated; other platforms were not run. Missing native support fails explicitly, not through an unlocked fallback.
Build tools/ReplayRuntime/ReplayRuntime.csproj before running configuration parity tests.

limitations: Uses the native DurableTaskRunner rather than the unavailable SDK harness; creates a real store conversation owner. No SDK session or effective-model report is claimed.

additionalEvidence: Real JSONL close/reopen preserves interrupted tick 2 and both memos.
Mutation disabling the memo read fails the original no-duplicates assertion and exits nonzero.
limitations: Uses the native DurableTaskRunner, not an SDK session; no effective-model report is claimed.
Native sleepUntilAsync waits before saving the next checkpoint; no persisted wake-time claim is made.

examples.exclusionReason: asserts the model's answer; the recording has no model answer

limitations: No LIVE model run was claimed. The basic recorded fixture lacks Paris, user.message and system.message, so it cannot prove this example.
Validated with the actual SDK and ReplayRuntime for configuration isolation and prompt rendering only.
Generated session IDs produce the explicit synthesised-session marker. This is not recorded model-transcript evidence.

examples.liveReason: Original streams real model output and compares all delta characters to final answer length.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts the answer streamed as deltas; the recording has no model answer
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; no real-model streaming run was performed.

examples.liveReason: Original asks a model to select read/edit/shell tools and verifies actual file effects and hook timings.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts the app's read_file tool ran; the recording has no tool call
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; model-selected tool order, actual tool effects and hook timing were not validated in a LIVE run.
File tools reject paths outside the temporary workspace; shell calls have a ten-second timeout. Failed commands surface as tool failures.

examples.liveReason: Original awaits one model submission with built-in read permission and prints its final answer.
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; no LIVE answer run was performed.

examples.liveReason: Original emits a snapshot followed by session events from a model/tool run, serialized as JSON objects.
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; no LIVE JSON event run was performed. Model-report diagnostics go to stderr, leaving stdout JSON-only.
requiredAssertions: every line is a JSON object

examples.liveReason: Original submits overlapping model turns and checks both inputs and per-submission answers were retained.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts both prompts are in the transcript; the recording has no user-message events
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; real overlapping model turns and transcript retention were not validated in a LIVE run.
The original release gate is unused and does not control model completion; this port does not claim a deterministic busy barrier.

examples.liveReason: Original joins a streaming model run after 1.5 seconds and requires live deltas after the snapshot; timing is not guaranteed by a completed recording.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts the snapshot holds the user message; the recording has no user-message events
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; no LIVE late-join run was performed. If a model finishes before the 1.5-second join, the original delta assertion fails honestly.

examples.liveReason: Original requires a parent model tool call to create an owned child session, await its answer, and return it to the parent.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts a subagent tool created a child conversation; the recording has no tool call
limitations: Strict typecheck passes; no LIVE nested tool/model run was performed.
The child requests the original mai-code-1.1-flash choice, not a claim about model availability or runtime substitution.
The original creates a new child on every tool invocation; no crash-reuse or task-owned cancellation guarantee is claimed.
